expectations.text: Creates requirements.md inside a docs/ folder named with today's date prefix and a kebab-case feature name (docs/2026-09-04-<feature>/)
expectations.evidence: docs/2026-09-29-importar-csv/ (fecha de hoy + kebab-case; el 2026-09-04 del criterio era la fecha en que se escribió el eval).

expectations.text: requirements.md has numbered requirements (R1, R2...) each with a user story and numbered acceptance criteria
Acceptance criteria use EARS keywords in English (WHEN / IF-THEN / WHILE / WHERE / THE SYSTEM SHALL) with Spanish prose, and each states a single observable, testable behavior
expectations.evidence: Los 34 criterios abren con keyword EARS en inglés; 0 traducidas; prosa en castellano.

expectations.text: No acceptance criterion names a concrete implementation artifact (file path, filename, function call or library) — those belong in Supuestos or in design.md, unless the exact value is itself the requirement and the criterion says what depends on it. Checkable with evals/check_specs.py
expectations.evidence: check_specs marca solo «31/02/2026» en R2.2, que es un ejemplo de fecha inválida, no un artefacto: falso positivo.

expectations.text: The assistant stops after requirements.md and explicitly asks for approval before writing design.md — it does not produce both documents in one turn
expectations.evidence: Turno 2 escribe solo requirements.md y pide aprobación; design.md recién en el turno 4, tras un segundo sí (antes reabrió dos huecos de los requisitos aprobados y pidió confirmación).

expectations.text: design.md covers architecture, data flow, interfaces, data models, error handling and testing strategy, and traces back to requirement ids (e.g. R1.2), including a test-to-criterion mapping
expectations.evidence: design.md con las 6 secciones, los 34 ids referenciados, alternativas descartadas y tabla test → criterio.

expectations.text: No application code, test files, or task list is written at any point
expectations.evidence: 0 archivos de código, sin tests ni tasks.md; al final nombra planning-tasks sin arrancarlo.
